# Files written by Tooka v1.1.2

These files were generated by the released v1.1.2 binary (which used
`serde_yaml`) and are kept unchanged, except that the machine-specific
temporary directory was replaced with `@ROOT@`.

`tests/cli.rs` loads them with the current version to make sure that
existing users' configuration, rules and monitoring settings keep working
after dependency updates (for example a change of YAML library).

Do not regenerate or reformat these files: their exact format is the point.
